description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Line_Array', which manages a sequential array of line styles for graph rendering, including methods to add styles, add colors, and retrieve line styles.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Line_Array
classes.description: A class that manages a sequential array of line styles for graph rendering, allowing addition and retrieval of styles.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line style object to the array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a color to the line styles array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the line style associated with a given ID, or the next in sequence.
